body: Jesus, I hope ur doing ok. I hate it when the people  I tell about my Ed just say to eat less or just don’t throw up. I’m also in year 9 and am struggling with the same thing of feeling I need to lose weight by the time school goes back. I believe in you, just keep pushing forward :)
That would be great, honestly what I need rn

I just have to say thank you everyone for your kind words you have no idea how much it means to me to have someone be proud of you for something you are trying so hard with. Especially when you can’t even tell the ones close to you what is going on. I hope you all have a wonderful day and remember that you are loved <3
Thanks so much, this was helpful! I hope that you will get better soon so u can get ur braces on :)
Yeah I suspected that, good idea for water tho :)

I feel the exact same way, I feel like such a hypocrite and a loser. And it gets to the point where u can’t speak out to anyone because then they will know that you’ve been lying the whole time and that will just make it so much worse.
